app.$description: App scope: dashboards, tools and system screens. Values here exist only for applications; everything else comes from shared.

sidebar.$description: Width of the sidebar on wide screens.

sidebar-collapsed.$description: Width of the collapsed sidebar: the toggle (nav-item) plus the side padding.

main.$description: Max width of the main content, without its padding. Extra space stays empty on both sides.

aside.$description: Width of the side column next to the main content.

nav-item.$description: Min height of a sidebar navigation item. Denser than a 40px control.

row.$description: Min height of a list row (agenda, people).

metric.$description: Min height of a metric cell.
